name: Seedance — retrieve your existing task only

parameters.content:
## Query an existing Seedance task
Install @acedatacloud/n8n-nodes-seedance, choose Resource → Task and Operation → Get, attach your saved service API credential, and replace the placeholder with a task ID you are authorized to read. Do not execute with the placeholder. This workflow has no generation or model node, embedded credential or pinned result. A successful query is not a new generation or billing receipt. Stop on 401/403 and check access; do not create a replacement task.
